Name: Expense Reporting
Description:
Contoso Ltd. seeks to modernize its expense reimbursement process, which currently relies on manual email submissions, spreadsheets, and delayed approvals. Employees often face challenges such as unclear policy guidelines, lack of real-time tracking for submitted claims, and inconsistent communication on reimbursement status.

Managing and tracking business expenses is often a manual and time-consuming process for employees and finance teams. Users struggle with submitting detailed expense entries, categorizing costs accurately, and ensuring that each expense is associated with the correct cost center. The process can also be prone to errors or delays due to insufficient automation or intelligence, such as AI-assisted categorization. There is a need for a streamlined and mobile-friendly solution that enables users to efficiently add, categorize, and review expenses, validate line items, and connect them to specific cost centers, all while leveraging AI to automate repetitive tasks and improve accuracy.

This solution leverages Generative Pages for rapid page creation, Power Apps Code Apps for advanced custom visualizations, and Power Automate for workflow automation, delivering an efficient, user-friendly, and scalable expense management experience.

Name: Operations Task Manager
Description:
The operations team in a large organization often struggles with coordinating multiple projects that span across departments such as engineering, compliance, customer success, and IT. Projects are frequently delayed due to poor visibility into dependencies, uneven workload distribution, and a lack of real-time progress tracking. Current tools may capture tasks but do not proactively monitor risks, escalate bottlenecks, or ensure alignment with organizational priorities. This results in inefficiencies, missed deadlines, and reactive firefighting instead of proactive project management.

To address this, the organization needs a task manager app purpose-built for operations, where managers can assign projects, monitor progress, and ensure cross-team collaboration in a streamlined way. The system should not only centralize task assignments but also provide intelligent monitoring, automated reminders, compliance checks, and data-driven insights. By enabling agents (both human and AI) to coordinate resources, flag risks, and optimize workloads, the app ensures projects are executed on time, within budget, and in alignment with strategic goals across the organization.

This solution leverages Model Driven App with Modern UX Gen Pages to enhance the user experiences and agent feed to show multiple agents which can talk to each other and act autonomously on Dataverse data.
